entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José María Torrijos y Uriarte, Count of Torrijos, a title granted posthumously by the Queen regent of Spain, also known as General Torrijos, was a Spanish Liberal soldier. He fought in the Spanish War of Independence, and after the restoration of absolutism by Ferdinand VII in 1814 he participated in the 1817 pronunciamiento of John Van Halen that sought to restore the Constitution of 1812, for which he spent two years in prison until he was released after the triumph of the Riego uprising in 1820.
